title: Screen Capture on Ubuntu GNOME Wayland
problem: Standard X11 tools (mss, PIL.ImageGrab) produce a blank 6KB black image on Wayland/Mutter.
solution: Use headless Google Chrome ('google-chrome --headless --screenshot=...') for webpages, or pyscreenshot with portal for desktop captures.

title: Path Normalization and Fuzzy Matching
problem: User queries often include '~', relative paths, or typos/spaces (e.g., 'muse agent' vs 'muse-agent').
solution: Use smart_resolve_path() from core.path_resolver to expand '~', check PROJECT_ROOT, and resolve space/hyphen variations.

title: Desktop Environment Variables for Subprocesses
problem: System tools for audio, media (wpctl, pactl), and notifications fail without runtime bus addresses, or when path is prefixed with '~' like '~/run/user/...'.
solution: Always set exact absolute path `env['XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'] = f'/run/user/{os.getuid()}'` (NEVER prefix with '~') and `env['DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS'] = f'unix:path=/run/user/{os.getuid()}/bus'`.

title: Automated Dependency Recovery
problem: Dynamic scripts fail if a required third-party module is not installed in the virtual environment.
solution: Catch ModuleNotFoundError, map the module to its pip package name, run pip install inside backend/venv, and re-execute.

title: Combine Existing Tools Before Making New Tools
problem: Compound requests (e.g. check system stats and list files) waste time synthesizing redundant new scripts.
solution: Chain primitives sequentially (e.g. sys_info -> fs_list -> FINISH) in the multi-step agent loop instead of MAKE_TOOL.

title: Never call grim or slurp on Ubuntu GNOME Wayland
problem: grim is designed only for wlroots/Sway compositors. On Ubuntu GNOME (Mutter), calling grim throws FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'grim'.
solution: Use python mss with sct.shot(), pyscreenshot, or the existing take_screenshot tool.

title: GNOME Notification DBUS Limitations
problem: The FreeDesktop notification specification does not mandate GetNotifications, and GNOME Shell does not implement org.freedesktop.Notifications.GetNotifications.
solution: Do not attempt to call GetNotifications over DBus. Inspect system logs via 'journalctl -b --user -u org.gnome.Shell' or read app-specific log files.

title: User Location Provided
problem: Agent checked weather or location-dependent info without knowing the user's location.
solution: Remember that the user lives in Nilambur and use this for location-based queries.

title: Avoid Forceful Mass Termination of Applications
problem: The agent used 'pkill -9 chrome' to close Chrome, which is disruptive and against user expectations when the task is simply to decide if a window is open or close specific instances.
solution: Rely on visual verification via screenshots and targeted window management rather than aggressively killing background processes.

title: Failed Media Playback Verification
problem: The agent claimed it played the media based on a click, but the user pointed out that the screenshot showed it wasn't playing and the click wasn't registered properly.
solution: Thoroughly inspect screenshots for playback indicators (e.g., play/pause state, progress bar movement) before confirming that media is playing.

title: Incorrect Screen Mapping Leading to Misclicks
problem: The agent attempted to interact with the desktop or open an app without properly mapping the screen size and coordinate space, resulting in misclicks into wrong applications like the Watcher app.
solution: Always verify screen resolution, layout, and exact coordinate mapping before executing mouse clicks or window navigation actions.
